claims: The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) is a non-profit organization.
The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) is a non-partisan organization.
The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) was founded in 1920.
The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) is dedicated to defending and preserving individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution and laws.
The ACLU protects free speech through litigation, advocacy, and lobbying.
The ACLU protects voting rights through litigation, advocacy, and lobbying.
The ACLU protects LGBTQ+ rights through litigation, advocacy, and lobbying.
The ACLU protects reproductive freedom through litigation, advocacy, and lobbying.
The ACLU protects due process through litigation, advocacy, and lobbying.
The ACLU files lawsuits such as Trump v. Barbara to challenge government actions believed to violate constitutional rights.
The ACLU protects freedom of speech even for unpopular groups.
The ACLU works to end mass incarceration.
The ACLU works to reform criminal law.
The ACLU defends disability rights.
The ACLU defends immigrant rights.
The ACLU has local affiliates in all 50 states and Puerto Rico.
The ACLU utilizes local affiliates to lobby legislatures.
The ACLU utilizes local affiliates to assist in local civil liberty cases.
The ACLU takes on high-profile cases concerning freedom of the press.
The ACLU takes on high-profile cases concerning the right to privacy.
Donations to the main American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) organization are not tax-deductible.
